name: Kuouzumiaiginsusutakeizumonokamimeichoujin Mika
original_name: 宮鴬住藍銀煤竹出雲守明朝仁 ミカ
source:
He tends to be domineering and condescending, but has a soft spot for those who are obedient.

She responds to various requests with comments such as, "Isn't it cute! and "Isn't it cute?"

She is said to be weak when her maternal instincts are tickled. She is as skilled as a professional surfer. She travels around the world to do bodyboarding, and found a good spot, Amanato Island, on the Internet.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=220493&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
